# Profit Rescue AI

> Business decision intelligence and public-data research. The site provides a free ecommerce profit calculator and lists three one-time research services.

Website: https://business-money-tools.vercel.app/
Calculator: https://business-money-tools.vercel.app/tools/ecommerce-profit-calculator
Agent manifest: https://business-money-tools.vercel.app/.well-known/agent.json
Machine-readable catalog: https://business-money-tools.vercel.app/api/catalog
OpenAPI document: https://business-money-tools.vercel.app/api/openapi.json

## Human-facing offers

- AI Visibility & Revenue Leak Audit — listed price: USD 499, one-time.
- Multi-Source Business Intelligence / Data Extraction — listed price: USD 999, one-time.
- B2B Prospect Intelligence Pack — listed price: USD 1499, one-time.

Prices describe the site's listed offers, not proof of a completed payment or delivery. Checkout availability and fulfillment must be confirmed for each order.

## Machine-to-machine status

- The company-intelligence endpoint is reserved at POST /api/v1/intel/company.
- The endpoint currently returns HTTP 503 with API_NOT_ENABLED.
- The endpoint does not return mock company records, and it does not initiate a charge.
- Machine execution, API-key issuance, usage metering, payment, and independently verifiable settlement are not yet enabled.
- API service prices are intentionally unpublished until execution and payment are connected and tested.

Agents should fetch /api/catalog before attempting any service. Do not treat a planned service as purchasable or rely on it for production workflows yet.
